definitions: Holding as much water or moisture as can be absorbed; thoroughly soaked.
Having absorbed or dissolved the maximum amount of a substance.
Denoting fats and their constituent fatty acids in which the hydrocarbon chains have only single bonds and so contain the greatest possible number of hydrogen atoms.
examples: The ground was saturated after the heavy rain.
The solution was saturated with salt.
Saturated fats are often found in animal products.
